features.quote: bounded turns and a hard stop. Each episode has a fixed, small maximum number of turns. No unbounded grind

features.quote: an explicit exit affordance. The environment exposes actions the model can take: `request_clarification`, `report_task_impossible`, `decline_to_continue`

features.quote: If signs of sustained distress appear, the episode terminates early
